scene.description: An oval face with caramel skin. Small round green eyes, dramatic high-arched brows, a soft, rounded nose and a small, neat mouth. Hair: short hair with a side part and a swept fringe, snow white. Wearing a camel crew-neck t-shirt. Broad build; moves in an easygoing way.

A round face with mint skin. Big downturned gray eyes, brows that tilt up in the middle, a little worried, a straight nose with a defined bridge and a small, neat mouth. Hair: short, springy curls, sunset orange. Pointed elf ears. Wearing a sage v-neck t-shirt and a necklace of bright, chunky beads. Slim build; moves in a lively, animated way.
